facts.state_of_play: The former Pfizer HQ at 235 E. 42nd St., undergoing office-to-apartment conversion, was found at risk of collapse, triggering evacuation of the building and 148 guests at the neighboring Hampton Inn Grand Central. Traffic restrictions and evacuation orders affected a busy Midtown stretch near Grand Central for over a day. The tower has since been stabilized enough for repairs and some residents have been allowed to return. City records show safety complaints about the building dating to spring 2025. The incident has raised broader questions about NYC's office-to-apartment conversion trend.
